title: If You Give A Seed A Fertilizer
description: Map seed numbers through range transformations to find the lowest location.
writeup:
## Approach

The almanac defines a chain of mapping stages (seed → soil → fertilizer → ... → location). Each stage consists of ranges that shift values by a fixed offset; values not covered by any range pass through unchanged.

## Part 1

Apply each mapping stage to individual seed values. For each value, check which range it falls in and apply the offset. Track the minimum final location.

## Part 2

Seed numbers are now huge ranges (start + length pairs), so mapping individual values is infeasible. The key insight is to map entire intervals at once: when an interval partially overlaps a mapping range, split it at the boundary — the overlapping portion gets the offset applied, the rest continues unmapped. Despite many splits, the number of intervals stays manageable through all stages.
